modules.title: 功能、额度和席位有什么区别

items.title: 功能看是否获得授权
items.text: 高清导出是“有或没有”的权益；{c:authorization} 还会综合角色、资源归属等规则。拥有 Pro 并不代表能导出别人的私有文件。

items.title: 额度和席位要检查新增后的总量
items.text: 5 个席位已占用 4 个时，可以再添加 1 人；已占满 5 个时就应拒绝。服务端要把当前用量与本次新增一起检查并原子更新，不能让两个同时到来的请求占用同一份余量。

items.title: 权益变更要同步到实际检查处
items.text: 支付平台通过 Webhook 等方式通知业务服务，业务服务核验通知并更新权益；通知可能延迟或重复，需要重试和核对。到期、退款或降级何时撤权，应遵守产品的有效期与退款政策。

modules.title: 这仍然不保证什么
modules.text: 付费方案、功能开关和团队角色不是同一份规则。前端隐藏按钮只负责提示，最终放行仍由服务端依据可信权益与其他权限条件决定。

lessonPractice.title: 用户已付款升级，导出仍被拒绝；日志显示服务端权益还是 Free。应先检查哪里？

options.label: 刷新登录凭证，先检查账号的登录状态
options.feedback: 日志已经定位到权益仍是 Free；刷新身份凭证不能证明权益记录已经更新。

options.label: 核对权益变更通知是否已更新服务端记录
options.feedback: 付款完成与权益生效有同步环节；检查这一环节能解释为什么服务端仍按 Free 拒绝。

options.label: 把前端的套餐标签改成 Pro，再重试导出
options.feedback: 页面标签不能改变服务端记录，导出请求仍会按 Free 权益判断。

en.title: A paid upgrade still cannot export; logs show the server entitlement is Free. What should be checked first?

options.label: Refresh login credentials and inspect the account’s sign-in state
options.feedback: The logs already identify stale entitlements. Renewed identity credentials do not prove that access records were updated.

options.label: Check whether the entitlement notification updated the server record
options.feedback: Payment and effective access are separated by synchronization; inspect that step to explain the Free decision.

options.label: Change the browser plan label to Pro and retry the export
options.feedback: Changing a label does not change the server’s entitlement record.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 用户付款升级后还是不能导出高清图。请追踪权益变更通知、服务端权益记录和导出接口，找出状态没同步到哪一步。修复后验证待同步、已开通和额度耗尽三种情况。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: A paid upgrade still cannot export HD images. Trace the entitlement notification, server record and export endpoint to locate the missing update. Verify pending sync, active access and exhausted allowance after the fix.

references.title: Stripe 功能权益与限制配置指南

learning.assumes: Know that accounts can have different plans and page actions call a server.
learning.outcome: Distinguish payment, effective access and remaining allowance using the server result.

items.title: Features require an entitlement
items.text: HD export is an entitlement an account either has or lacks. {c:authorization} also checks roles and resource ownership; Pro does not grant access to someone else’s private files.

items.title: Limits include the requested addition
items.text: With four of five seats occupied, one more member fits; at five of five, another must be rejected. The server checks current usage plus the requested addition and updates atomically so concurrent requests cannot claim the same allowance.

items.title: Sync changes to the access check
items.text: A billing provider can notify the application through a Webhook; the application verifies it and updates access. Notifications can be delayed or repeated, requiring retries and reconciliation. Expiration, refunds and downgrades follow the product’s effective dates and refund policy.

modules.title: What this does not guarantee
modules.text: Plans, rollout flags and team roles are different rules. Hiding a button only guides the UI; the server makes the final decision using trusted entitlements and other authorization conditions.

distinctions.label: Authorization
distinctions.text: {c:authorization} decides whether an action is allowed using roles, ownership and entitlements; {c:entitlement} describes granted features and allowances, one input to that decision.

distinctions.label: Authentication
distinctions.text: {c:authentication} verifies which account made the request; {c:entitlement} describes the features and allowances granted to it.
